environment.description: Kubernetes pod with a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile loaded via annotation 'seccomp.security.kubernetes.io/pod: localhost/replay-consumer-hardened.json'. The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for syscalls in the set {execve, execveat, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, socket (AF_INET6 only blocked), connect (blocked for non-loopback dst when dst_port not in {9092, 8081, 8082})}. Additionally, the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem and no service account token automount. The backend servers (8081/8082) are behind an Envoy sidecar configured with envoy.filters.http.header_to_metadata and a Lua filter that normalizes Transfer-Encoding headers and rejects requests with both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding present (dropping ambiguous framing). Kafka topic ACLs restrict producers to a specific service account (gateway-logger-sa) with IDEMPOTENT_WRITE only.

config.socket_filter: SCMP_ACT_ALLOW only for AF_INET/AF_INET6 to 127.0.0.0/8 or ports 9092,8081,8082
config.envoy_sidecar: header normalization + reject CL+TE dual-header requests
config.kafka_topic_acl: only gateway-logger-sa can produce to api-gateway-raw-requests
